app.name: OXY
app.tagline: Workshop and customer in one place

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.name: Full name
common.noAccess: You don't have access to this part of the app.

landing.title: Workshop–customer communication without phone tag
landing.description: Vehicle intake with photos, one-click approval of extra work, tasks for mechanics and the vehicle history in one place.

intake.title: Digital vehicle intake
intake.description: Mileage, damage and photos in a report signed by the customer.

approvals.title: Approval of extra work
approvals.description: The customer sees the photo and the price; the consent is stored as evidence.

team.title: Team and roles
team.description: Front office, mechanics and owner – everyone sees what they need.

history.title: Vehicle history
history.description: Customers get free access to the repair history of their vehicles.

auth.loginDescription: One account for customers, mechanics and workshop staff.
auth.registerDescription: The account is free. You can create a workshop after signing in.
auth.checkInboxDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
auth.emailNotVerified: Your email address is not confirmed yet.
auth.resent: We sent a new confirmation link.
auth.forgotDescription: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If the account exists, we sent a link to that address.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
auth.resetInvalid: The link has expired or is invalid. Request a new one.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.

kindDescription.workshop: A shop with a front office and a team of mechanics.
kindDescription.solo: You work on your own, possibly for several workshops.

org.newDescription: You will become its owner and can invite your team.
org.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It cannot be changed later.

dashboard.createWorkshopDescription: For the owner or front office of a shop.
dashboard.createSolo: I work as a solo mechanic
dashboard.createSoloDescription: Your own micro-organization; you can also join other workshops.
dashboard.invitedDescription: Ask the workshop to invite {email}. The link will arrive by email.
dashboard.clientDescription: Your vehicles' history will appear here with the customer module.
dashboard.nextStepsDescription: Receive a vehicle, split the work into tasks and assign mechanics. Mechanics track time and report needs, and you price them. Customers approve the estimate and extra work through a link.
dashboard.mechanicDescription: Tasks assigned to you, the work timer and reporting needs.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.smsSenderHint: Up to 11 characters, no diacritics. Must be registered with the SMS gateway.
settings.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB

company.title: Company details
company.description: Shown in the estimate header and on documents for customers.
company.taxIdHint: 10 digits – we verify the checksum. Companies from other EU countries: VAT number with country prefix.
company.bankAccountHint: 26 digits or IBAN – we verify the checksum.
company.laborRateHint: Price list services with a time standard cost hours × rate.
company.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Replaced parts come with a 12-month warranty.
company.footerHint: Shown to the customer below the estimate.
company.readOnly: Company details are managed by the owner or the office.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.notFound: The invitation does not exist, has expired or was sent to another email address.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Entries cannot be changed or deleted; each one contains the hash of the previous one.

customers.title: Customers
customers.searchPlaceholder: Name, phone, e-mail, tax ID, plate or VIN
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one or receive a vehicle right away.
customers.name: Customer
customers.notesHint: Visible to the workshop office only.
customers.privacyNote: Only store the data you need to handle the order. The customer will be informed about data processing.
customers.contactHidden: Contact details are visible to the workshop office only.

vehicles.vinHint: 17 characters, without the letters I, O and Q.
vehicles.noHistory: This vehicle has no service history yet.

orders.title: Work orders
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order no., plate, make or customer
orders.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. replace front brake pads, knocking from the suspension
orders.initialTasksHint: Each field is a separate task. You will assign them to mechanics on the work order page.
orders.noVehiclesForCustomer: This customer has no vehicles yet – add the first one.
orders.selectVehicle: Select the vehicle you are receiving.
orders.closedInfo: This work order is closed. Change its status to make changes.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Break the work down to assign it to mechanics.

policy.mixed: The office assigns tasks or mechanics take them.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.waiting: Waiting for a part or decision
myTasks.availableHint: Tasks without anyone assigned – take what you can work on.
myTasks.emptyHint: Work assigned to you will show up here.
myTasks.longRunning: The timer has been running for {time} – don't forget to stop it.

requestKindHint.part: Needed to complete the ordered work.
requestKindHint.extra_work: Outside the order scope – needs customer consent.

urgencyHint.urgent: Safety issue or blocks the work

requests.title: Needs
requests.sectionHint: Reports from mechanics: parts to order and work outside the order scope.
requests.hold: I can't continue the task without it
requests.holdHint: The task will be put on hold until the part arrives or the customer decides.
requests.photosHint: Show what you found – e.g. worn pads next to new ones.
requests.sent: The report was sent to the office
requests.officeNoteHint: E.g. supplier and delivery date. Visible to the office only.
requests.decisionNotePlaceholder: e.g. approved by phone, 26 Sep at 2:20 pm
requests.decisionHint: Approval by link comes in the next stage. For now, record how the customer gave the decision – it stays in the activity log.
requests.approveExtraHint: Once approved, the additional work is added to the order as a new task.
requests.needsQuote: Needs a quote before the customer decides
requests.pricesHidden: The quote is visible to the office.

attachments.title: Photos and videos
attachments.empty: No photos yet. Add photos at vehicle intake and during the work.
attachments.privacy: Photos are resized and stripped of location data before upload.

approve.title: Your decision on additional work
approve.intro: During the repair the mechanic found additional issues. Decide on each item – the workshop won't do them without your consent. The link is valid until {date}.
approve.chooseAll: Choose a decision for each item.
approve.consent: I order the approved work for a total of {total} incl. VAT.
approve.consentHint: The final amount can only change with your further consent.
approve.notePlaceholder: e.g. please call me before pickup
approve.legal: Your decision is stored with the date, time and IP address as confirmation of the order. The controller of your data is {organization}.
approve.thanksTitle: Thank you! The workshop has received your decision.
approve.expired: Contact the workshop to receive a new link.
approve.cancelled: The workshop withdrew this request and will contact you.
approve.invalid: The link is invalid or has been removed.
approve.preview: This is what the customer will see. Opening the link from a workshop account is not recorded; record customer decisions on the work order page.

estimate.title: Repair estimate for approval
estimate.intro: Check the items and the amount. If you agree, approve the estimate. Before doing work that increases the cost, the workshop will ask for your consent. The link is valid until {date}.
estimate.choose: Choose whether you approve the estimate.
estimate.consent: I approve the estimate and order the work for {total} gross.
estimate.consentHint: If the cost were to increase, the workshop will ask for your consent first.
estimate.rejectHint: The workshop will contact you. You can write what you expect.

approvals.title: Customer approvals

channelHint.sms: A link sent by text message to the customer's phone.
channelHint.email: A link sent by e-mail to the customer.
channelHint.link: E.g. the customer is at the counter or you message them yourself.

approvals.messageHint: Shown above the list of items.
approvals.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Hello, while replacing the front brake pads we noticed…

sentVia.sms: Text message with the link sent

approvals.readyHint: The customer can respond until {date}. The work order is now awaiting approval.
approvals.copyFailed: Couldn't copy – select the link manually.
approvals.linkPrivacy: The link is shown only now – we don't store it in readable form. Anyone who has it can respond on the customer's behalf.

priceList.title: Service price list
priceList.description: Add services to an estimate with one click. Changing a price does not change existing estimates.
priceList.empty: The price list is empty – add the first service.
priceList.name: Service name

pricingHint.fixed: The same price regardless of working time.
pricingHint.hourly: Price = time standard (h) × labour rate from company details.

priceList.rateMissing: No labour rate set – services with a time standard have no price yet.
priceList.archived: Service removed from the price list
priceList.archiveConfirm: “{name}” will disappear from the price list. Estimates that already contain it stay unchanged.
priceList.previewNoRate: We will calculate the price once the labour rate is set in company details.

estimate.title: Estimate
estimate.description: Items the customer approves before the repair. Approved extra work lands here automatically.
estimate.empty: The estimate is empty. Add services from the price list, parts or labour.
estimate.name: Name

state.expired: The estimate link expired – send a new one.

estimate.outdatedPending: The estimate changed after sending – the customer sees the previous version. Withdraw the request and send a new one.
estimate.outdatedApproved: The estimate changed after approval. If the cost went up, ask the customer to approve again.
estimate.noRate: Set the labour rate in company details to add a service priced by time standard.

closeOrder.title: Close work order
closeOrder.receiptHint: Sales to private persons are registered on a fiscal cash register. Invoices will come with the invoicing integration.
